svg.title: Architect 2.0 architecture
svg.desc: Layered architecture of the Architect 2.0 frontend: user, auth and onboarding, the workspace shell with Manager chat and right workspace, project tools (Canvas, Code with Architect Guard, GitHub, Deploy), the underlying runtime, state and design-system layers, and the external browser handoffs. Implemented, simulated and external elements are distinguished by stroke style.
svg.text: Browser-only single-page application · React 18 · Vite 5 · TypeScript · HashRouter · Zustand persisted to localStorage · Tailwind 3 — no server, database, model call or sandbox in this repository
writes user into the store; signs out locally
step is persisted, so a refresh resumes there
integration choices are a polished mock
no projects → FirstRun; otherwise “Select a project”
ThreadRoute / DmRoute fall back to the Manager
seedDemo() seeds one demo project on first load
managers[] · activeManagerId · one identity per Manager
avatar click toggles the drawer · + Add Manager
fixed inset-0 z-40 · 60% scrim · 288 px wide
opens from the rail avatar / TopBar identity
state projectDrawerOpen — not persisted · not docked
TOP BAR — identity · tools: UI Head · Code · GitHub · Deploy
identity button toggles the project drawer · account menu · “UI Head” also opens the UiDemoVideoDialog teaser
· routedTo[] · addressedToUser · ts · read · optional inline card
grouping: 5-minute author turns; agent chatter collapses to one activity line
composer: Enter sends, Shift+Enter newlines, grows to five lines
replies are scripted intent matches (scripts.ts) — no model call
pushManagerMessage / pushUserMessage mirror other actions in here
moment the Manager brings someone in
once Manager brings the team in”
5 fixed specialists — no agents are created
at runtime and nothing is executed anywhere
thread is created together with the
an unintroduced agent has no thread,
so DmRoute redirects to the Manager
same Message model, addressed to you
conversations are stored per project, so a
DM never leaks across projects or Managers
intent routing — the Manager names who it brings in
states: idle · building · live · error (with retry)
viewport: desktop 100% · tablet 720 px · mobile 390 px
sections reveal as build tasks complete
scrolling is contained — only the generated document
scrolls, never the panel (a flex-1 min-h-0 well)
the markup is canned per template id — no code is generated
links.ts classifies a pasted URL locally (http/https only)
session.ts is module-local: live Window handles, not persisted
every step is mirrored into the Manager transcript
a feed window closes when the build goes live or errors
a blocked popup is reported, never claimed as opened
play/pause drives a 1-second visual timer only — no audio
seek and volume sliders are keyboard operable
a pasted music link is queued, then opens on its platform
Canvas is full-bleed: on /p/:projectId/canvas the right workspace is hidden and the conversation takes the whole width.
tools open as routes inside the same shell
3 · PROJECT TOOLS — top-bar routes inside the shell · each reads the same persisted store
CanvasView.tsx · CanvasDoc lives in the store
staged 4-step analysis at 0.6 s per step
file list is keyed by previewTemplateId — only
“streaks” is populated and is the fallback
regex highlighter · “Explain file” is fixed prose
connection; no OAuth and no API call
“Commit build” appends a local commit record
local or accepting main → new commit + toast
preview | production; needs a successful build
logs stream on a timer from 7 canned lines
a QR code and copy link; Open site → demo
production is simulated to fail with a reason
the uploaded image is never read: analysis
writes a canned layout; the edits are real
Guard findings never block a build, and the
1.5 s scan is a timer — no analyser runs
account, repo, branch and history live only
in the store — nothing is pushed anywhere
rollback adds a new version pointing at the
chosen one; retry re-runs the same steps
browser handoffs — the only thing that leaves the app
window.open for one video, or a
the URL is classified locally and only
opener is nulled; Architect closes only
the handles it opened, never your tabs
return is read from visibility or focus —
never from what happened in the tab
no backend, API server or handlers
no database — localStorage is the only
persistence, and it is per browser
no OAuth provider: sign-in and the
no LLM or agent orchestration: every
reply is scripted data in the store
no sandbox, container, CI or deploy
4 · UNDERLYING LAYERS — what every surface above is built from
touch-targets.css is imported outside the Tailwind build
npm run build = tsc -b && vite build
persisted: user · projects · threads · builds · previews
local-only: toasts, imports, managerViewMode, drawer open
tailwind.config.js + index.css hold one token set
primitives: Button · Row · Modal/Dialog · Popover · Panel
Toaster · Identity — one focus ring, reduced-motion switch
